Overview

Słupsk is a city in Pomeranian with a population of 90,380. A charming city in northern Poland near the Baltic coast, known for its Gothic architecture, the Witkacy Museum, and a growing technology sector. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
